articles.title_en: The unintended consequences of accountability: Quasi-experimental evidence from policing in Pakistan
articles.title_cn: 问责制的意外后果：来自巴基斯坦警务的准实验证据
articles.abstract_en: We investigate data manipulation in the principal-agent relationship using administrative microdata from the police in Pakistan. We find that police are less likely to register citizens’ crime reports in areas where political accountability pressure is higher because the governing party holds a particular constituency. We report a series of tests to rule out the possibility that this result is explained by increased crime prevention. The results are consistent with officials deciding not to register some reports, under pressure to keep crime statistics low. As a new crime reports tracking database is rolled out, improving observability, the number of registered crimes increases.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用巴基斯坦警方的行政微观数据，研究委托-代理关系中的数据操纵行为。我们发现，在政治问责压力较高的地区，即执政党持有特定选区时，警方登记公民犯罪报告的意愿较低。我们进行了一系列测试，以排除这一结果是由犯罪预防增强所解释的可能性。结果与官员在压力下决定不登记某些报告、以保持犯罪统计数据较低的情况一致。随着新的犯罪报告追踪数据库的推出，可观测性提高，登记犯罪的数量也随之增加。

articles.title_en: Access to credit reduces the value of insurance
articles.title_cn: 信贷获取降低了保险的价值
articles.abstract_en: We study how access to credit markets affects the value of insurance. Loans allow consumers to smooth financial shocks over time, reducing the incremental benefits provided by insurance. We derive tractable formulas for the value of insurance that can be taken to data and show how that value varies with loan features. We then apply our framework to health insurance. Access to a five-year loan decreases the values of community- and experience-rated health insurance for the average two-person household by $232–$366 (58–61%). Even for the sickest decile, loan access reduces the value of community-rated insurance by $1099 (17%). Our results suggest that greater credit availability can serve as a substitute for health insurance.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了信贷市场的获取如何影响保险的价值。贷款允许消费者随时间平滑金融冲击，减少了保险提供的增量收益。我们推导出可用于数据的保险价值简便公式，并展示了该价值如何随贷款特征变化。然后我们将我们的框架应用于健康保险。获得五年期贷款使平均两人家庭的社区评级和经验评级健康保险的价值降低了$232–$366（58-61%）。即使对于最病重的十分位人群，贷款获取也使社区评级保险的价值降低了$1099（17%）。我们的结果表明，更大的信贷可用性可以作为健康保险的替代品。

articles.title_en: Taxation and business entry: Evidence from the Polish self-employment “Flat” tax
articles.title_cn: 税收与创业进入：来自波兰个体经营“统一”税的证据
articles.abstract_en: How does the tax treatment of entrepreneurial activity affect the decision to start a business? We study this question in the context of a major tax reform in Poland that introduced a flat tax for business owners, leaving the taxation of employees unchanged. Using a difference-in-differences approach and data on the universe of Polish taxpayers, we find that a 1 percentage point increase in the tax differential at the top of the income distribution leads to a 0.9% increase in the share of self-employed five years after the reform. The increase is primarily driven by transitions from employment to self-employment, in particular, solo self-employment (self-employment without dependent workers). Moreover, the transitions occur in industries with a high human-capital component. Altogether, we find that high-income taxpayers respond strongly to the increased attractiveness of self-employment by starting a business, that such behavior shows considerable persistence, that it accumulates over time, and much of it is likely to reflect income reclassification rather than genuine entrepreneurial activity.
articles.abstract_cn: 创业活动的税收待遇如何影响创业决策？我们在波兰一项重大税制改革的背景下研究这一问题，该改革为商业所有者引入了统一税，而雇员的税收保持不变。使用双重差分方法以及波兰纳税人全量数据，我们发现，在收入分配顶端，税收差异每增加1个百分点，改革五年后个体经营者比例增加0.9%。这一增长主要由从就业转向个体经营，特别是独自个体经营（无受抚养员工的个体经营）所驱动。此外，这种转变发生在人力资本密集的行业。总体而言，我们发现高收入纳税人对个体经营吸引力的增加反应强烈，通过创业来应对，这种行为表现出相当的持续性，随时间累积，且其中很大一部分可能反映的是收入重新分类而非真正的创业活动。

articles.title_en: Better late than never? Quantifying funding and liquidity effects of the PPP on pandemic-era employment recovery
articles.title_cn: 迟做总比不做好？量化PPP在疫情时期就业复苏中的资金与流动性效应
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines how the Paycheck Protection Program (PPP) supported employment during the COVID-19 period by distinguishing between its short-term liquidity and broader funding effects. Using county-level data, we show that delays in loan disbursement had prolonged negative impacts only on the smallest urban businesses. To identify the causal impact of funding itself, we develop an instrument based on the pre-pandemic payroll share in small establishments. Instrumental-variable and firm-level analyses reveal that PPP funding improved business survival and employment recovery substantially and broadly, with an estimated cost of roughly $89,000 per job-year, consistent with other large-scale fiscal interventions.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文通过区分短期流动性和更广泛的资金效应，考察了薪资保护计划（PPP）在COVID-19期间对就业的支持作用。利用县级数据，我们表明贷款发放的延迟仅对最小的城市企业产生了长期的负面影响。为了识别资金本身的因果影响，我们基于小企业疫情前工资份额构建了一个工具变量。工具变量和企业层面的分析显示，PPP资金显著且广泛地改善了企业生存和就业复苏，估计每工作年成本约为89,000美元，与其他大规模财政干预措施一致。

articles.title_en: Intertemporal substitution in response to non-linear health insurance contracts
articles.title_cn: 对非线性健康保险合同的跨期替代反应
articles.abstract_en: I explore how non-linear health insurance contracts allow consumers to substitute healthcare in one period for healthcare in another period by increasing consumption in the year the annual deductible was met and decreasing future consumption. I exploit variation in the timing of an injury that generates significant healthcare expenses to identify the causal effect of meeting the deductible on healthcare consumption in the following year. Estimates indicate that there is intertemporal substitution across years in healthcare consumption and that consumers are able to strategically respond to non-linear pricing schemes to undermine the potential savings from deductible plans.
articles.abstract_cn: 我探讨了非线性健康保险合同如何允许消费者通过增加达到年度免赔额当年的消费并减少未来消费，从而在一个时期用医疗保健替代另一个时期的医疗保健。我利用一次产生重大医疗费用的伤害发生时间的变异，来识别达到免赔额对次年医疗保健消费的因果效应。估计结果表明，医疗保健消费存在跨年度的跨期替代，且消费者能够策略性地应对非线性定价方案，从而削弱免赔额计划可能带来的节省。

articles.title_en: Identifying tax-setting responses from local fiscal policy programs
articles.title_cn: 从地方财政政策项目中识别税收设定反应
articles.abstract_en: This paper provides event-study evidence on the dynamics of strategic tax-policy interactions. Using the participation of German municipalities in state debt reduction programs as a quasi-exogenous shock, we demonstrate how these programs affect tax rates of participating municipalities. We then illustrate how competing municipalities – not directly affected by the program – adjust their tax rates in response. Combining both steps using a two-sample Wald estimator, the strategic response of competitors to a one-unit tax change by program participants ranges from 0.66 to 0.70 for the local business tax and 0.34 to 0.49 for the property tax. Characteristics of municipalities, especially proximity, influence the size and scope of tax interdependence.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提供了关于战略性税收政策互动动态的事件研究证据。利用德国市政当局参与州债务减免计划作为准外生冲击，我们展示了这些计划如何影响参与市政当局的税率。然后，我们说明了未直接受计划影响的竞争市政当局如何调整其税率以作出反应。通过使用两样本Wald估计量结合这两个步骤，竞争对手对计划参与者一单位税收变化的战略反应，对于地方营业税而言，范围在0.66至0.70之间，对于财产税而言，范围在0.34至0.49之间。市政当局的特征，尤其是邻近性，影响税收相互依赖的程度和范围。

articles.title_en: Can early public childcare reduce child penalties? Evidence from Germany
articles.title_cn: 早期公共托育能否减少育儿惩罚？来自德国的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the effects of public childcare expansion for children under age three in Germany on mothers’ child penalties. Exploiting county-level variation in the expansion, we find that a 20-percentage-point increase in childcare coverage rate reduces earnings penalties by 4.5 percentage points. This accounts for about 56% of the total 8-percentage-point decline in earnings penalties over the reform period. Early childcare increases employment and days worked, especially in full-time and non-marginal positions. It also raises daily wages and increases the likelihood that mothers work in higher-paying firms and occupations. These effects persist beyond the early childcare eligibility period. We further identify two key contextual factors explaining the positive effects of early childcare: the initial level of child penalties and reliance on informal care. In settings with high child penalties and limited alternatives, early public childcare can yield substantial lasting benefits for mothers’ careers.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了德国三岁以下儿童公共托育扩展对母亲育儿惩罚的影响。利用县级扩展差异，我们发现托育覆盖率每增加20个百分点，收入惩罚减少4.5个百分点。这约占改革期间收入惩罚总下降8个百分点中的56%。早期托育增加了就业和工作天数，尤其是在全职和非边缘职位上。它还提高了日工资，并增加了母亲在高薪企业和职业中工作的可能性。这些影响在早期托育资格期之后仍然持续。我们进一步识别了两个解释早期托育积极影响的关键背景因素：育儿惩罚的初始水平和依赖非正式照料的程度。在育儿惩罚高且替代选择有限的环境中，早期公共托育能为母亲的职业生涯带来显著的持久益处。

articles.title_en: The compliance effects of the automatic exchange of information: Evidence from the Swiss tax amnesty
articles.title_cn: 自动信息交换的合规效应：来自瑞士税收大赦的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the effects of the 2017 multilateral automatic exchange of information (AEoI) on tax compliance in Switzerland. Using detailed administrative tax data and difference-in-differences designs, I document large and persistent compliance gains. The AEoI triggered around 107,000 taxpayers (about 2% of all) to enter Switzerland’s tax amnesty, disclosing CHF 37.6 billion of previously hidden wealth (over 5.5% of GDP). At the micro level, once they enter the amnesty, participants increase reported wealth by roughly 50% on average, with effects sustained in the medium run. Finally, the evidence indicates that tax evasion in Switzerland is widespread and comparatively more evenly distributed across the wealth distribution than in other countries.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了2017年多边自动信息交换（AEoI）对瑞士税收合规的影响。利用详细的行政税收数据和双重差分设计，我记录了显著且持续的合规收益。AEoI促使约107,000名纳税人（约占所有纳税人的2%）进入瑞士的税收大赦，披露了此前隐藏的37.6亿瑞士法郎财富（超过GDP的5.5%）。在微观层面，一旦进入大赦，参与者的报告财富平均增加约50%，且这一效应在中期内得以持续。最后，证据表明，瑞士的逃税现象普遍存在，且与其他国家相比，逃税在财富分布中的分布相对更为均匀。

articles.title_en: Almost fare free: Impact of a cheap public transport ticket on mobility patterns and train delays
articles.title_cn: 几乎免费：廉价公共交通票对出行模式和火车延误的影响
articles.abstract_en: During June–August 2022, Germany temporarily reduced the fare of unlimited local and regional public transport nationwide to €9 per month. We study changes in mobility behavior and rail congestion effects induced by this 9-Euro Ticket. We employ difference-in-differences and event-study designs to analyze data from mobile-network devices, administrative traffic counts from road monitoring stations, and train arrival data. We find a strong increase in rail travel with modest substitution away from cars. Train trips rise by around 35%, while car traffic falls by 1–5%, with the smallest traffic reductions during commuting times and the largest increases in rail travel for leisure purposes on weekends and to touristic destinations. Moreover, the train demand surge materially worsens service quality via elevated train delays, which even spill over to long-distance trains. A welfare analysis suggests that the policy mostly acted as a cost-of-living transfer with limited emissions benefits, implying high implicit CO2 government abatement costs. Overall, our findings indicate that deeply discounted, nationwide “go-anywhere” tickets can substantially increase railway travel, yet generate limited car-to-rail substitution and strain service reliability when implemented without accompanying capacity extensions.During June–August 2022, Germany temporarily reduced the fare of unlimited local and regional public transport nationwide to €9 per month. We study changes in mobility behavior and rail congestion effects induced by this 9-Euro Ticket. We employ difference-in-differences and event-study designs to travel data from mobile-network devices, administrative traffic counts from road monitoring stations, and train arrival data. We find a strong increase in rail travel with modest substitution away from cars. Train trips rise by around 35%, while car traffic falls by 1–5%, with the smallest traffic reductions during commuting times and the largest increases in rail travel for leisure purposes on weekends and to touristic destinations. Moreover, the train demand surge materially worsens service quality via elevated train delays, which even spill over to long-distance trains. A welfare analysis suggests that the policy mostly acted as a cost-of-living transfer with limited emissions benefits, implying high implicit CO2 government abatement costs. Overall, our findings indicate that deeply discounted, nationwide “go-anywhere” tickets can substantially increase railway travel, yet generate limited car-to-rail substitution and strain service reliability when implemented without accompanying capacity extensions.
articles.abstract_cn: 六月至八月2022期间，德国暂时将全国无限次地方和地区公共交通票价降至每月9欧元。我们研究了这种 9-Euro Ticket 引起的出行行为的变化和铁路拥堵效应。我们采用双重差分法和事件研究设计来分析来自移动网络设备的数据、来自道路监控站的行政交通计数以及火车到站数据。我们发现铁路出行强劲增长，汽车出行有适度替代。火车出行量增加了约 35%，而汽车交通量则下降了 1-5%，通勤期间的交通量减少幅度最小，而周末休闲和前往旅游目的地的铁路出行量增幅最大。此外，火车需求激增导致火车晚点增多，严重恶化了服务质量，甚至波及长途火车。福利分析表明，该政策主要作为生活成本转移，排放效益有限，这意味着政府的隐性CO2减排成本很高。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，大幅折扣的全国范围内“去往任何地方”的车票可以大幅增加铁路旅行，但在不扩大运力的情况下，产生的汽车到铁路替代有限，并会导致服务可靠性紧张。 六月至八月2022期间，德国暂时将全国范围内无限制的本地和区域公共交通票价降低至每月欧元9。我们研究了这种 9-Euro Ticket 引起的出行行为的变化和铁路拥堵效应。我们采用双重差分法和事件研究设计来获取来自移动网络设备的出行数据、来自道路监控站的行政交通计数以及火车到站数据。我们发现铁路出行强劲增长，汽车出行有适度替代。火车出行量增加了约 35%，而汽车交通量则下降了 1-5%，通勤期间的交通量减少幅度最小，而周末休闲和前往旅游目的地的铁路出行量增幅最大。此外，火车需求的激增导致火车晚点增多，从而严重恶化了服务质量，甚至波及长途火车。福利分析表明，该政策主要作为生活成本转移，排放效益有限，这意味着政府的隐性CO2减排成本很高。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，大幅折扣的全国性“去往任何地方”的车票可以大幅增加铁路旅行，但在不扩大运力的情况下实施时，会产生有限的汽车到铁路的替代，并导致服务可靠性紧张。
